map.输入温度和相对湿度，计算露点温度、水汽压、体感温度及舒适度等级。: Enter the temperature and relative humidity to compute the dew point, vapor pressure, apparent temperature and comfort grade.
map.📖 查看「露点舒适度计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Dew Point Comfort Calculation User Guide"
map.露点舒适度 = f(温度, 露点): Dew point comfort = f(temperature, dew point)
map.露点采用 Magnus-Tetens 经验公式，精度约 ±0.4°C: The dew point uses the Magnus-Tetens empirical formula, with an accuracy of about ±0.4°C
map.体感温度采用澳大利亚表观温度公式（无风、无辐射修正）: The apparent temperature uses the Australian apparent temperature formula (no wind or radiation correction)
map.高温高湿时酷热指数（Heat Index）自动启用，结果仅供体感参考: At high temperature and humidity the heat index is automatically enabled; the result is for apparent-temperature reference only
map.📚 深度解析：相对湿度与体感: 📚 In-depth: Relative Humidity and Apparent Temperature
map.由干湿球或露点气温算: Compute from dry/wet bulb or dew point and temperature
map.解释「同样温度不同湿度体感不同」。: Explain "the same temperature feels different at different humidity".
map.RH<30% 干（咽干静电）、>70% 潮（霉闷），40%–60% 最舒适，加湿: RH<30% dry (dry throat, static), >70% humid (mold, stuffiness), 40%-60% most comfortable; target humidification/dehumidification at this.
map.相对湿度一天怎么变？: How does relative humidity change over a day?
map.水汽量相对稳时，升温 RH 降、降温 RH 升，所以清晨 RH 最高、午后最低。: When the moisture content is relatively stable, rising temperature lowers RH and falling temperature raises RH, so RH peaks in the early morning and is lowest in the afternoon.
map.多为温漂与滞后，定期用盐饱和溶液校准，避免长期偏差。: Mostly due to temperature drift and lag; calibrate regularly with saturated salt solutions to avoid long-term bias.
map.输入气温与相对湿度，利用 Magnus-Tetens 公式计算露点温度和水汽压，: Enter the air temperature and relative humidity to compute the dew point and vapor pressure via the Magnus-Tetens formula, determine the human comfort grade using the temperature-humidity index (THI), and compute the heat index at high temperature and humidity to assess heat-stroke risk.
